details.description:
One day, a strange âX-mark Incidentâ sweeps through town. Whenever something precious is marked with an X, it stops working and becomes unusable, plunging the city into chaos. As Anna and the Star Detective Precure begin their investigation, a fairy client named Rain appears and begs them to protect a girl named âKarinâ from mysterious creatures known as the âDame-Dameâ.
Guided by Rain, they arrive at a place as beautiful as a dream: Karinâs Garden. There they meet Karin and Alan, the fairy who watches over her. Both fairies clearly hold Karin very dear. Anna and her friends quickly befriend Karin and start looking into the case. Dame-Dame suddenly appear even in this peaceful garden. Where did these creatures come from? What secret lies deep within the garden and between Rain and Alan? 
A brand-new mystery is about to begin.

details.description:
One day, a strange âX-mark Incidentâ sweeps through town. Whenever something precious is marked with an X, it stops working and becomes unusable, plunging the city into chaos. As Anna and the Star Detective Precure begin their investigation, a fairy client named Rain appears and begs them to protect a girl named âKarinâ from mysterious creatures known as the âDame-Dameâ.
Guided by Rain, they arrive at a place as beautiful as a dream: Karinâs Garden. There they meet Karin and Alan, the fairy who watches over her. Both fairies clearly hold Karin very dear. Anna and her friends quickly befriend Karin and start looking into the case. Dame-Dame suddenly appear even in this peaceful garden. Where did these creatures come from? What secret lies deep within the garden and between Rain and Alan? 
A brand-new mystery is about to begin.

details.name: IMAX Godzilla Minus Zero
details.title: IMAX Godzilla Minus Zero
details.description:
War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. 
Two years have passed since then.

 

Through agonizing struggles, the country achieved recovery and finally reclaimed its daily life. 
Now, a new pinnacle of despair attacks, completely crushing all hope.


Moving beyond Godzilla Minus One, the film that won the Academy Award for Best Visual Effects and captivated the world.

There is no third time. Everything ends here.

details.title: Trial of Hein (GFF)
details.description:
After fourteen years away, Hein returns to his remote North Sea island home, only to discover that the close knit community no longer recognises him. Even his childhood friend keeps his distance, and convinced he is an impostor, the villagers convene a court to determine his true identity. As his memories contradict every witness's account, suspicion curdles into open hostility, forcing Hein to confront what he has long refused to see. The debut feature of director Kai StÃ¤nicke, whose screenplay draws on his own coming out experience, probes how memory and identity are shaped and distorted.

 

2026    Teddy Jury Award, Berlinale

details.title: The Family Approach (GFF)
details.description:
Almost like family, but always temporary: in a house beside an idyllic lake, three youth workers do everything they can to create a home for the children in their residential care. Between parental love, bureaucracy, and youth welfare services, they cook, comfort, read bedtime stories â and fight an often overwhelmed system on the children's behalf. Shift after shift, they offer what these kids need most: safety and someone on their side. A film about the superpower of raising a child, and family in all its forms.

details.name: Prosecution (GFF)
details.title: Prosecution (GFF)
details.description:
Young German-Korean prosecutor Seyo Kim is determined to bring far-right extremists to justice in Germany. When she survives a racist attack on her own life, she defies her superiors and takes the perpetrators to court herself, uncovering a right-wing network with ties deep into the institutions meant to stop it. Director Faraz Shariat's second feature is grounded in years of meticulous research into Germany's legal system and its handling of far-right violence, a subject that feels urgent at the moment.

 

2026    Panorama Audience Award, C.I.C.A.E. Award, Heiner Carow Prize, Berlinale

details.description: Berlin, 1931. A city gripped by fear: a child murderer is at large, and the police are closing in â but so is the criminal underworld, whose trade is disrupted by the relentless manhunt. When Hans Beckert is finally cornered, he faces not a court of law but a kangaroo trial in a basement, forced to plead for his life before the very men society has condemned.  Fritz Lang's debut sound film remains a masterwork of moral complexity. Drawing on the real-life case of Peter KÃ¼rten, Lang wields silence, shadow and Edvard Grieg's haunting leitmotif to ask an unsettling question: who has the right to judge?

details.title: IMAX Dune: Part Three
details.description:
From Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures comes Dune: Part Three, bringing Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Denis Villeneuveâs epic trilogy to a breathtaking conclusion.

 

Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

details.name: Swan Lake (Paris Opera Ballet 2026 - 2027)
details.title: Swan Lake (Paris Opera Ballet 2026 - 2027)
details.description:
Broadway Cinemas is proud to exclusively present the Paris Opera Ballet's spectacular 2026-2027 season! Kicking this season off are two world-renowned ballet classics coming straight to the big screen: Romeo and Juliet and Swan Lake.

 

Prince Siegfried is urged by his parents to choose a bride, but by the shores of a lake he meets a mysterious swan maiden, Odette, enchanted by the sorcerer Rothbart. Only a sincere vow can save her. Captivated, he swears eternal love, until he meets Odile, the black swan...

 

A magical ballet set to Tchaikovsky's sparkling music, Swan Lake was first created in 1877 for the Bolshoi Theatre in Moscow, later restaged by Marius Petipa and Lev Ivanov. Nearly a century later, Rudolf Nureyev brought his own interpretation to the Paris Opera in 1984.

details.description:
In the seedy underbelly of 18th-century Paris, money is king. Nothing is sacred â even love itself can be bought for the right price. A native of this hedonistic underworld, Manon is caught between twin desires when she falls in love with the student Des Grieux. Steadfast and devoted, he offers the possibility of an honourable life. Yet, the riches promised by the world of Parisian society remain tempting...


Manonâs inner turmoil and struggle for survival lie at the devastating heart of Kenneth MacMillanâs 1974 adaptation of AbbÃ© PrÃ©vostâs novel. In this signature work of The Royal Ballet, MacMillanâs nuanced understanding of human psychology makes for an unflinching look into the moral degradation of Manonâs Paris, while all its decadence and decay are brought to life through Jules Massenetâs score and Nicholas Georgiadisâs designs.

details.title: Made in Hong Kong (bc30)
details.description: The first film in Fruit Chan's "Handover Trilogy", this raw, low-budget film tells a story about forgotten youth. With no hope for the future, four teenagers struggle between broken homes and street violence: Moon becomes a street hoodlum; Susan takes her own life after heartbreak; Ping is terminally ill and abandoned by her father; and Sylvester, who has an intellectual disability, is used to smuggle drugs. As tragedy strikes, what remains is a desperate cry against the world that abandoned them.

details.name: Happyend (bc30)
details.title: Happyend (bc30)
details.description: In near-future Tokyo, a prank on the school principal leads to the installation of an oppressive surveillance system. While the incident awakens high schooler Kou's political consciousness, his best friend Yuta remains oblivious, creating a rift that threatens their bond. Following Ryuichi Sakamoto: Opus, Neo Sora delivers a poignant feature debut exploring whether adolescent bonds can survive a volatile political landscape. While met with a modest reception in its native Japan, the film resonated deeply in Hong Kong, its first overseas theatrical stop, paving the way for the widespread international attention that followed.

details.name: Hidden Heroes (bc30 x APAAA)
details.title: Hidden Heroes (bc30 x APAAA)
details.description: Officer Yohji Ho meets a female android who comes from the future, in a drug raid. The android's mission is to ensure the death of Yohji, the elder brother of the future "Father of electronic Chips", so as to help the future scientist to become what he will be. At the meantime, Yohji is suspected as the murderer of a police officer. Scared and confused, Yohji flees and goes to Mei Ling, who looks identical to the android, for a fraud passport. Knowing Mei Ling is his brother's future wife, Yohji decides to kill her to save his own life. Being pursued by the police and the android, Yohji runs away with Mei Ling and starts their adventure.

details.name: Fatherland (bc30)
details.title: Fatherland (bc30)
details.description:
In the summer of 1949, at the height of the Cold War, Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a challenging and emotional road trip in a black Buick, which takes them across a Germany in ruins. Returning home after sixteen years of exile in the US, Mann has to face not only a divided fatherland, but also a deep fracture within his own family. With Fatherland, Pawlikowski explores the themes of identity, family, love and guilt amid the turmoil and confusion of post-war Europe in his elliptical, distilled style.

 

Best Director Award, Cannes Film Festival

details.description:
At a cosy Christmas party, young Clara meets the mysterious magician Drosselmeyer, who gives her a nutcracker doll. When the guests have departed and the house is asleep, Clara sneaks downstairs in search of the doll. Instead, she finds Drosselmeyer, who whisks her away on a journey into a whole world of enchantment: fantastical landscapes of flurried snow and glittering confection where toys come alive and the magic never stops. 


Peter Wrightâs production of this festive family favourite sparkles to the wondrous swell of Tchaikovskyâs orchestral score, alongside the glow and grandeur of Julia Trevelyan Omanâs period designs.

details.description:
Present-day Taipei. Tao, consumed by an inexplicable affection for the indifferent Shin, seeks to preserve their bond through pain. Meanwhile, Melih, a former Istanbul resident running a noodle shop, receives an unexpected flower from the perpetually drunk Ping. As he fixates on the flower, he becomes entangled in Tao's story, reflecting on his own struggles with human connection. Through these intertwined narratives, the film examines the fragility of memory and the ways we attempt to hold onto, or let go of the past.

 

CPH: DOX
 

This special screening comes with a pair of socks.

details.description: 1999, a young woman leaves her quaint seaside house and returns to the city, leaving in the mailbox a card for the next owner, with instructions to forward any mail of hers to the new address. 1997, a jaded young architect moves into the same house and finds the letter. Following the box office success of Christmas in August and Shiri, Il Mare further cemented the growing influence of Korean cinema.

Her encounter with Mari, a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path and perspective on the world. By forming a deep, supportive friendship, the two women join forces in a shared struggle to make the impossible possible.

 

Best Actress Award, Cannes Film Festival

details.description:
Paris, 1835. At twenty-five, FrÃ©dÃ©ric Chopin is the toast of Parisian salons, adored by the aristocracy and the King. Behind the glamour of nighttime escapades, he conceals an illness with wit and humor. Though time is slipping through his fingers, he refuses to slow down. He composes masterpieces while teaching to make ends meet. Admired by friends and adored by women, Chopin ultimately discovers that amidst the fleeting fame, music is the most important thing in his life.

details.name: Paper Tiger (bc30)
details.title: Paper Tiger (bc30)
details.description:
In James Gray's deeply felt and intense drama, two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be "too good to be true." As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences. Shattering the "American Dream" beneath layers of atrocity and corruption, the latest work of Ad Astra's James Gray is a slow-burn family melodrama pondering just how fragile blood ties sometimes are.

 

Competition, Cannes Film Festival

details.title: All of a Sudden (bc30)
details.description:
Director of a care facility for the elderly, Marie-Lou strives to introduce an innovative care philosophy named "humanitude", which is rooted in active listening and respecting residents' dignity, despite strong resistance and disagreement from some of her staff. Her encounter with Mari, a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path and perspective on the world. By forming a deep, supportive friendship, the two women join forces in a shared struggle to make the impossible possible.

 

Best Actress Award, Cannes Film Festival

details.title: Jeanne Dielman, 23, Quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles (FCP 2026)
details.description:
Jeanne, a widow, lives in a one-bedroom flat in Brussels with her son Sylvain. She never really loved her husband, and has no intention of ever remarrying. A few small changes to her routine over a thirty-six hour period culminates with something she's never experienced with one of her clients, which threatens what she knows her life to be. She has to decide how that incident will affect her psyche.

 

The film will be introduced by the "Directors' Fortnight's Artistic Director Julien Rejl  on 28 NOVEMBER at PREMIERE ELEMENTS.

The film will be introduced by the "Directors' Fortnight's Artistic Director Julien Rejl on 28 NOVEMBER at PREMIERE ELEMENTS.

details.name: Cube (bc30)
details.title: Cube (bc30)
details.description: Six different people, each from a different walk of life, awaken inside a giant cube with thousands of rooms. The identical rooms hold the threat of hideously inventive and painful death. Each gifted with a special skill, they must work together to escape an endless maze of deadly traps. Finding the real exit, however, may not offer the freedom one seeks. A micro-budget pioneer of the escape-room genre that grew into a cult sensation, the film was released at bc in 2002 to introduce local filmgoers to this overlooked gem.

details.title: Spare Queens
details.description: In bowling, there is nothing more daunting than the 7-10 split, which leaves two side pins in a position that is almost impossible to knock down. In this stirring sports film, the infamous split serves as a metaphor for not only a long-standing rivalry between two retired female bowlers, but also rare second chances to correct past mistakes. Produced by the team behind sleeper hit Love Lies (48th), this directorial debut shows us that bowling involves far more than just hitting wooden pins with a ball â it requires precise timing, immense strength, and grace under pressure.

Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. The latest work from Oscar-winning director Martin McDonagh is a poignant story of friendship and the devastating gap between the ideal and reality, accompanied by his trademark incisive dialogue and dark humour.

 

Best Actor Award, Venice International Film Festival

In rural France, Christophe tries to live up to his rigid, distant father on the family farm. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning, on the tractor, at school, at dinner. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, hediscovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend and follows her into his first mischief. But will any of this really fix what is out of balance?

 

Un Certain Regard Special Jury Prize, Cannes Film Festival

details.description:
Since October 7, 2023, Agence France-Presse reporters Mai Yaghi, Adel Zaanoun, Mohammed Abed and Mahmoud Hams were among the few independent witnesses to Israelâs response to the Hamas attack, while international colleagues were being denied free access. Inside Gaza captures not only what happened, but also the personal struggles of journalists risking their lives to inform the world and confront the ethical, physical and emotional toll of covering a conflict few others could see. A compelling, first-hand account of the fight to keep journalism alive in the face of siege and silence.

Winner of the Best International documentary award at Doc Edge 2026, Grand Prize of the Hinzpeter Awards, Best Feature Documentary at FIGRA 2026, and 2026 laureate of the Roman Brodmann Prize for Political documentary, Inside Gaza is now qualified for OscarÂ® consideration.

details.title: Coward (FCP 2026)
details.description:
On the Western Front of World War I, young soldier Pierre is eager to prove himself, but repeatedly retrieving the bodies of fallen comrades slowly shatters his courage. When an army show is organized to boost morale, Pierre is assigned to help build the set. On stage, Francis
performs as a woman, his captivating charm stirring the young soldier's heart. While war rages outside, an untimely romance quietly takes root between them. Following Close, director Lukas Dhont captures forbidden love blooming against the brutality of war, led by two emerging actors who shared the Best Actor award at Cannes.

 

Best Actor Award, Cannes Film Festival

details.title: Persepolis (bc30)
details.description: Based on Marjane Satrapi's autobiographical graphic novels, Persepolis follows a rebellious and outspoken young Iranian girl, Satrapi, growing up in Tehran during and after the 1979 Islamic Revolution. Like other girls her age, Satrapi is full of imagination and longs to freely explore the world. However, with the arrival of the revolution, everything has changed. Through her eyes, we witness the fall of the Shah, the rise of the fundamentalist regime, the devastating IranâIraq War, and the tightening restrictions on women's freedoms. In light of the mass protests that erupted in 2025, the war with Israel and the passing of Satrapi this June, rewatching the film feels all the more poignant.

details.name: Iron Boy (FCP 2026)
details.title: Iron Boy (FCP 2026)
details.description:
In rural France, Christophe tries to live up to his rigid, distant father on the family farm. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning, on the tractor, at school, at dinner. A doctor finds the solution: Christophe must wear an iron corset to keep himself upright. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, he discovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend and follows her into his first mischief. But will any of this really fix what is out of balance?


Un Certain Regard Special Jury Prize, Cannes Film Festival

details.description:
Present-day Taipei. Tao, consumed by an inexplicable affection for the indifferent Shin, seeks to preserve their bond through pain. Meanwhile, Melih, a former Istanbul resident running a noodle shop, receives an unexpected flower from the perpetually drunk Ping. As he fixates on the flower, he becomes entangled in Tao's story, reflecting on his own struggles with human connection. details.description:
In the near future, movies have long since become outdated. Lao Zha is a janitor at a film studio for 20 years, living only with an abandoned cat "actor". When the studio is closing down, the boss can no longer afford his salary and gives him a VR headset instead. Lao Zha, now jobless, unexpectedly enters a whole new world of virtual reality. The dazzling digital world is more alluring than the cold, harsh reality. Animation director Xu Zao makes a stunning debut, capturing the anxiety and emptiness of urban life.

Fuyuko lives quietly, working as a freelance proofreader, her days largely free of contact with others except for occasional outings with an outgoing colleague. Her only personal ritual is walking alone through the city at midnight on her birthday. A subtle shift begins when she meets Mitsutsuka, a reserved high school physics teacher, at a local culture center. Drawn to his gentle manner and his words, Fuyuko begins meeting him regularly at a cafÃ©. As their encounters slowly accumulate, a fragile sense of connection takes shape. Yet both carry things they do not easily reveal.

 

Un Certain Regard, Cannes Film Festival

details.name: Gold Life (HKAFF)
details.title: Gold Life (HKAFF)
details.description:
At 40, is a woman just entering the prime of her life, or is her fate already sealed? Zhang Xin is about to complete her PhD, yet she finds herself torn between being a good mother and pursuing her ambition. She wants her child to grow up close to nature, but has to give up a teaching position in the city. Independent filmmaker Zhang Xin wrote, directed and starred in this film using a mockumentary style, weaving her own experiences into the script, enlisting non-professional actors and allowing improvisation to capture the essence of real life.

 

Best Narrative Feature, FIRST International Film Festival

details.description: Owen, once a celebrated stage director, has spent more than a decade lost in creative paralysis. details.name: To You in the Beyond
details.title: To You in the Beyond
details.description:
On the lush, remote Tokishima lies a mysterious place known as the âSpirited Away Cove.â
After leaving the city due to personal circumstances, high school student Kazuki Tsukigase begins a new life on the island. One early summer day, he discovers an unconscious girl at the cove.
Her name is Nanao Aika.
Claiming to have come from the year 1974, Nanao is taken in by Kazuki and a man named Takatsu, who happens to be at the cove when they find her. Intrigued by the mysterious girl, Kazuki begins visiting her after school, until one day Nanao reveals a shocking truth.
When the past and the present converge, the future of two people bound by hidden secrets begins to unfold.

Bryan Cranston (Breaking Bad) and Marianne Jean-Baptiste (Hard Truths) feature in a five-star, triumphantly acclaimed new production of Arthur Millerâs classic play, from visionary director Ivo Van Hove (A View from the Bridge).


One family, the heart of the American dream. details.name: Let the Right One In (bc30)
details.title: Let the Right One In (bc30)
details.description: Set in the Stockholm suburb of Blackeberg in 1981, Oskar, a bullied 12-year-old, strikes up a friendship with his new neighbour, the mysterious and moody Eli. She is full of contradictions; her wise look, her strange smell, the fact that she is wearing such thin clothing, her neglected and skinny, yet so beautiful, appearance. Initially reserved, a sweet romance blossoms between them. But a dark, macabre secret revealing Eli's connection to a string of bloody local murders threatens everything. Along with Black Ice, it sparked a new wave of interest in Nordic crime movies at the time, including films such as The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo and Headhunters.

details.name: NAZA
details.title: NAZA
details.description: Under the cover of night on Tel Aviv rooftops, Israeli intelligence operatives break their silence to expose the chilling mechanics behind modern warfare. Filmed in secret over three years, this unflinching investigation confronts the lethal deployment of artificial intelligence in Gaza, where black-box algorithms systematically reduce living families into cold data points. As automated surveillance turns airstrikes into an assembly line of calculated destruction, what remains of human conscience when life and death are outsourced to code?

details.name: Good Trip
details.title: Good Trip
details.description: Shan, an art assistant, juggles responsibilities on the film set and at the hospital, where she cares for her father, Kuen. During her time at the hospital, Shan is tasked by the crew to collect a big bowl from the prop-studio. At her father's request, they discreetly leave the hospital together, embarking on an unexpected journey from the studio to Macau, and subsequently to Okinawa, allowing Kueng to address his unfulfilled wishes. Following his peaceful passing, Shan inherits not only memories but also a lasting sense of courage, optimism, and imaginative spirit that sustains her throughout life.

Seeking redemption, Lan now collects strange objects believed to hold the lingering spirits of those who died unnatural deaths, helping them find peace.

 

When police officer Huang Ming begins investigating a series of suspicious âaccidents,â he repeatedly encounters Lan at the scenesâsometimes even before they occur. Through her connection with the dead, Lan reveals a chilling truth: the accidents are actually carefully staged murders.

Determined to change things up, she leaves Foon and his hostesses with no choice but to transform and modernize in order to breathe new life into their business. Little do they know, a powerful conglomerate has been pulling the strings all along to shut down Club EJ for good.

 

To save their neon empire, Foon and V must join forces and make an epic last stand with the hostesses against what seems to be inevitable doom.

details.name: Farewell to my Concubine (4K Restored Version)
details.title: Farewell to my Concubine (4K Restored Version)
details.description:
Douzi, a boy with feminine features, is abandoned by his prostitute mother to an all-boys Peking opera troupe supervised by Master Guan. Douzi befriends fellow trouper Shitou.

A few years later in 1938, a teenage Douzi is trained to play dan (female roles), while Shitou learns jing (painted face male roles). When practicing the play "Dreaming of the World Outside the Nunnery", Douzi intentionally mistakes the line "I am by nature a girl, not a boy" with "I am by nature a boy, not a girl," subjecting himself to severe physical punishments. Douzi along with another student, Laizi, attempt to run away, but Douzi decides to pursue acting seriously after witnessing an opera performance. Upon returning, they find the whole troupe being punished for their desertion, and Douzi is beaten. As a result, Laizi hangs himself...

details.title: HEAT (4K Restoration)
details.description:
Heat is a gripping crime thriller directed by Michael Mann, starring Academy AwardÂ® winners Al Pacino and Robert De Niro. Neil McCauley (Robert De Niro), a highly skilled and disciplined professional thief who leads a crew specializing in high-stakes heists across Los Angeles. On the other side is Vincent Hanna (Al Pacino), a relentless LAPD detective whose dedication to his job matches McCauleyâs commitment to his criminal craft.

As McCauley and his crew plan their biggest score yet, Hanna and his team close in, leading to an intense game of cat and mouse. Both men struggle to balance their personal lives with their professional obsessions, blurring the lines between hunter and hunted. The film builds to a climactic confrontation, exploring themes of loyalty, sacrifice, and the thin line separating lawmen from lawbreakers.

Renowned for its realistic action sequences, complex characters, and the legendary face-off between Pacino and De Niro, Heat is considered a landmark in the crime genre.

details.title: Pulp Fiction (4K Restoration)
details.description:
A stunning 4K restoration of this masterpiece will return to big screen celebrating its 30th anniversary. 

Jules Winnfield and Vincent Vega are two hitmen out to retrieve a suitcase stolen from their employer, mob boss Marsellus Wallace. Wallace has also asked Vincent to take his wife Mia out a few days later when Wallace himself will be out of town. Butch Coolidge is an aging boxer who is paid by Wallace to lose his next fight. Honey Bunny and Pumpkin are a couple of young lovers and small time thieves who decide they need a change of venue. The lives of these seemingly unrelated people are woven together in a wildly entertaining and exhilarating motion picture adventure that both thrills and amuses.
